title: Initial Sprint 2 engine (YOLOv8n ONNX + light IoU tracker + Farneback + rules)
key_results: Thresholds tuned on train against draft labels; draft-label agreement was also computed on the Test split during this phase (see threats to validity).
notes: Reconstructed from the development chat of 4 Nov 2026 and git history; no stored metrics file. Not an experimentally verified result.

title: Replace the light IoU tracker with a NumPy port of ByteTrack
hypothesis: Two-stage association with a Kalman filter keeps Vehicle B's identity through low-score frames better than greedy IoU matching.
changes: TRACKER: iou -> bytetrack (BT_TRACK_THRESH=0.5, BT_LOW_THRESH=0.1, BT_MATCH_THRESH=0.8, BT_TRACK_BUFFER=30 at 30 fps scaled to 10 fps)
key_results: Port output identical to the official ByteTrack code on 149/149 clips (re-checked 2026-11-10). Train+val: tracks per clip 7.55 -> 4.92; mean track length 20.7 -> 22.6 frames; B coverage in last 2 s 0.798 -> 0.787; collision within 0.5 s of source annotation 0.699 -> 0.691 (before SIYAQ-BUG-001).
notes: Preliminary: equivalence is verified; the accuracy comparison uses source crash frames and draft labels only.

title: Collision moved to a later jolt after the tracker change
hypothesis: With ByteTrack, B's track lasts longer; the last-frame bonus and the 0.6 size gate let a later jolt or the cut-in moment win.
key_results: Team-reported video: impact 6.234 s -> 5.037 s with both trackers.
notes: Single reported clip; aggregate effect not separately recorded.

title: Lane-change boundary detection
hypothesis: Start = onset of inward lateral motion; end = impact when B is lost within the tracker buffer.
changes: _lane_change_bounds(); LANE_VEL_HALF=2; LANE_ONSET_MPS=0.4 (chosen on train from 0.2-0.6); EDGE_PX=2
key_results: Human clip dada_training_type11_53: 10-19 -> 14-21 (GT 15-22). Draft train (n=22) tIoU 0.380 -> 0.512; draft val (n=4) 0.330 -> 0.407.
notes: Draft-label numbers are not verified accuracy.

title: Provenance of event measurements (observed/estimated/inferred)
hypothesis: Values carried from B's last tracked frame were shown as measured at the impact.
changes: events[].sources added; no value or threshold changed
key_results: dada_training_type11_53: collision distance 2.86 m is from frame 19, reported for frame 21 -> labelled inferred.

title: Wrong Vehicle B selection (000023)
hypothesis: Impact-anchored selection (jolt anchor, closeness, approach, continuity) picks the vehicle involved.
key_results: Reviewed B correct 1/2 for both current and candidate; candidate val collision hit 18 -> 16 of 22 (regression).
notes: Separate cause proven: the reviewed B is lost by the detector 10-11 frames before contact.
